strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
and Blast Dragon destroyed
Joe!? At this rate...!
I know! But we're almost there! Almost to Earth!
But it's going to be close. We just took a hit near the engines!
Shaff! Is the Elshank gonna hold together!?
...I don't know... But as Joe said, Earth is right there.
If we can just make it that far...!
Tch, they caught up!
It's a Sherman!
They've been closing the distance. This is bad, Joe!
Dammit! Get ready to launch, Mike! Lenny!
Aw, gimme a break!
I wanted to arrive in one piece, though.
Quit griping and intercept them!
Hey, Gameran! You can still make atmospheric entry to Earth, right!?
Buy us some time! Engine output is dropping!
...Tch, what a mess.
At times like this... if only Ilbora were here...
Princess Romina! Forget about that traitor!
We've got no choice but to do this ourselves now!
Joe, you bastard!
You don't know how Lord Ilbora, our guard captain, felt leaving us...
Shut up!
I don't wanna understand some guy who ditches his princess and runs!
Isn't there anything you can do!? Joe, Mike, Lenny.
We're so close to landing on Earth... Joe! What are we gonna do!?
If we try to force a descent... we'll be sitting ducks! Big Bro!
Argh! Don't all talk at once! I know we're in trouble!
Joe, atmospheric entry in three minutes! Before then...
If you can't handle it, we're leaving you behind!
I said quit yappin'! ...Tch, so there's a time limit!
No helping it... guess we gotta do it! Mike! Lenny!
So we take down the Sherman in one go, then.
So it's brute force in the end. Aw, man.
Quit whining, Mike!
We can't let these guys get into Earth, can we!
...Grrr... is this it? To think I'd miss my window to descend to Earth...!
It's taking evasive action...? Don't tell me!
He who fights and runs away... and all that.
You've done well... but remember this: once they're dealt with, you're next!
What!? Another new model we've never seen!?
It hasn't reached Earth yet...!
That battleship!?
From Earth? Then isn't that a ship Hazard sent after us!?
Bringing down the big ones is Grendizer's job. I'm launching!
Launching!
This time we stop it for sure, Lieutenant!
Oh? They're fighting...?
Are they opposing forces...? No, that red robot is...
...A mech of the Za Boom Army, the one attacking Mars.
Then they're descending to Earth too!?
What's up, Captain Bright?
You're not yelling at us to launch like you always do.
We can't exactly not go out, can we?
Right. We know the Za Boom Army is our enemy, but...
What on earth is that paper-crane-like battleship...
...We can't just sit on our hands like this. What about communications?
They're jamming us. We've been trying for a while now, but...
We'll have to go out. If they shoot, they're enemies, right, Captain?
Not a rational way to tell friend from foe, but it'll do... Let's go.
They're sending out all kinds of stuff too! What do we do, Big Bro!?
Hold your fire for now! I don't wanna hurt any Earthlings!
Joe! Don't be so soft! Anyone who shoots at us is an enemy!
No, Gameran... I don't want to harm the people of Earth if I can help it...
Somehow, we must get through this.
Hmm, if only something would give us an opening.
An energy reading...!? More of them!?
This reading...! Joe!
What!? Where did that come from!?
This is... terrifying mobility... Can we even lock on to it...?
I knew it, that's...!
Princess, could this be...!?
Yeah, looks like I can time the descent now... Tobikage!
Princess! We're entering the atmosphere! Please take your seat!
That battleship... It's moving!
Oh no! We're still nowhere near close enough...!
Joe, Mike, Lenny! Please return to the Elshank!
We're out of time...!
Leave them be, Princess! Your seat belt!
Don't leave us! ...All right! We're heading back, Mike, Lenny!
Whew! I thought we were done for!
Thanks, Tobikage!
Unbelievable... We failed to stop them again...!
But... neither they nor that small robot that showed up afterward...
...ever attacked us, did they?
Seems like there's a story there, but...
...Lieutenant, looks like this isn't the time to think about it.
Excellen's right. It seems... we're the target this time.
I'll contact the Gandor unit on the ground!
All pilots in the field, sweep this sector clean!
We can't let any more of these unknown forces descend to Earth...!
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Hmm... So this is Mia Alice's homeland... Earth.
I see... A beautiful blue planet. ...But...!
What!? More robots we've never seen...!
What on earth is happening in the Earth Sphere!?
No, Daisuke, look closely!
Some of those are robots from that Gyandlar bunch we fought before!
Is that their new model!?
Hoho... So this must be the planet's defense force.
Heh heh heh... Crushing them to get things rolling might be amusing...
Boss Gil Berg, word is you oughta be careful of those guys...
...That's what Devil Saturn No. 1 said, anyway.
Hah! Don't lump me in with the likes of them. ...Right, begin the attack!
I'll give them a good taste of the terror of the Bunker!
The Bunker? Captain, did you record that transmission?
Yes... It's not a name I've heard.
But... they're clearly working with that last organization.
Either way, it's creepy. Brother, what do we do?
We have to fight... We can't let the surface fall into any more chaos...!
Here they come!
Not bad, but... you're still powerless!
Did you think numbers that small could make any difference!?
Ngh, there's so many...! They're overpowering us!
At this rate, we'll be worn down...!
...Is this... kinda bad?
Heh heh heh...! At this rate, Earth's forces are nothing special!
Perhaps I'll descend at once and run wild until Mia Alice arrives...
Heh heh heh, haaah ha ha ha!
Doing as he pleases...!
I won't let you...! Not my... second home...!
Home? Heh heh heh,
savor your own powerlessness as you watch that home of yours perish...
Kenrou!!
Wow! If it isn't our hero making another grand entrance!
Sticking your neck in again, Rom?
...Well, I don't plan on leaving scum like this alone either.
No kidding. This planet's got it rough, though. Things are getting crazy.
Drill, save the chatter for later! Everyone!
Let's join forces and do our best!
I'm grateful, certainly... but somehow...
...The vibe, right? Still, they're reliable!
Rom... was it? Sorry, but please lend us your strength again!
That is why I have come once more. ...Here I go!
Insolent fool! I'll teach you a lesson!
...Grrr... is this it? To think I'd miss my window to descend to Earth...!
It's taking evasive action...? Don't tell me!
He who fights and runs away... and all that.
You've done well... but remember this: once they're dealt with, you're next!
Brother! We have to go after him!
That's right, Rom! If they're in cahoots with the Gyandlar...
...No, we mustn't pursue too far.
The Bunker... If they truly are those space pirates...
...this won't be easy.
...Yeah. This could get messier than we imagined...
The Bunker...? Space pirates...? What are they talking about?
...They seem to know something, but...
For now, let's defeat the remaining enemies. Here we go...!
Brother! We have to go after him!
That's right, Rom! If they're in cahoots with the Gyandlar...
...No, we mustn't pursue too far.
The Bunker... If they truly are those space pirates...
...this won't be easy.
...Yeah. This could get messier than we imagined...
The Bunker...? Space pirates...? What are they talking about?
...They seem to know something, but...
For now, let's defeat the remaining enemies. Here we go...!
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
That Za Boom battleship got away from us, but...
...the rest seems taken care of. Now... what to do about them...
Looks like you've saved us again. ...Thank you, truly.
Not at all. Even without us... I'm sure you would have been fine.
That's about right. This planet seems to be in some turmoil, but...
if you can't win against this much, I fear for what lies ahead.
Hey, Jet! That's rude, isn't it!?
No, he may be right.
We haven't even figured out who our many enemies truly are.
The Captain is right.
...What do you say? We want as much information as we can get.
...I'm sorry... but we have a mission of our own. ...Besides...
Master Rom!? Kenrou is...!
Hm...! Everyone... we must go.
Let us meet again... someday.
I'd love to visit sometime, though. Such a pretty planet. ...See you!
Later, then!
Jeeeeeeet!
Here one second, gone the next. His sword was kinda glowing, though...
Brother, those people really are...
Yes... Not just from what they said... They're definitely not Earthlings.
I mean, that pointy-headed guy in shades, any way you look at it...
...doesn't look like there's a pilot inside.
Maybe he looks a little like Captain Quattro?
Just the sunglasses.
That's enough.
I'll contact Commander Hazuki of the Gandor unit about that battleship.
We let two battleships descend to Earth...
We need to decide our next move quickly. All units, return to base.
...With these forces, there's little we can do... We must do something.
